message: 踊りへっぽこ版

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, hey, Nana-chan. What are we doing for the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You girl, weren't you listening at the general assembly!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep, I was sleeping. So, what are we doing?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good grief, this girl...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, Synn. What are we doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Pretty sure they said something about dancing, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Wait, you were actually listening!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. I've got super sharp ears, you know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Dancing, huh... Whose idea was this?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it was Misa--」
It was Misasagi-senpai's idea, but it might be better not to tell Nanaka

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was it Misa?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then why don't we just ask Misa?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, good idea!\s01　Well, I'll go ask her」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Have a nice triiiip\s07」
I wonder where Misasagi-senpai is?

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai!\s08」

name: Ria
message: 「What's up? Coming all the way to my classroom\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... is Misasagi-senpai around?」

name: Ria
message: 「Misasagi... chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes. I have some business with Misasagi-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Oh, I see. Hold on just a second, okay\s02」
Sigh... Is there really nothing I can do about how my heart starts pounding every time I look at Ria-senpai?

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm Ayane Misasagi」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I already know that\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hehe... President, Rii-a's over there sulking, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She's got a look on her face that says, 'Why wasn't it me~?'」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I mean, my business was with you, Misasagi-senpai...」
As I say that, I can't help sneaking glances over toward Ria-senpai.
And she's been glaring straight over here the whole time...

name: Misasagi
message: 「Business with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Earlier, about the Holy Night Festival dance party... I wanted to ask what kind of vibe you were hoping for」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Awfully sorry to put you out, makin' you go along with my selfishness like this. Let's see~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you picturing something like ballroom dancing, after all?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nothing quite so stiff and formal. Havin' everyone dance casually and enjoy themselves is what's best」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, wouldn't it be better if folks learned at least a little bit of how to dance beforehand?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. If everyone learns a few simple steps in advance, we'll all be able to have fun on the day of」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Can you dance, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm embarrassed to admit it, but I can't even do a proper Bon Odori」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In that case, why don't you have Rii-a take you by the hand and teach you step by step?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-With Ria-senpai, hand-in-hand?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I couldn't possibly...\s03」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just kiddin'」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, hey! What are you two talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai!\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Mr. President. About what we were just talking about--on second thought, you'd better drop it.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「After all, a boy is supposed to take the lead with a girl, you know~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Wha--?! What's that supposed to mean--?!」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Excuse me!\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah! Hey, Synn-kun!! Get back here--!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hehehe... Honestly, those two are such a gloomy pair.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sy~nn-kun♪」
Whoa, that's a huge smile.

name: Ria
message: 「What were you and Ayanishiki-chan talking about just now~?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Give me a break already...」

name: Ria
message: 「If you don't tell me--」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah! I got it, I'll talk--! So please spare me--!」

name: Ria
message: 「I didn't even say anything yet.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I didn't know how to dance, so I was wondering what to do. And then, Misasagi-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ayanishiki-chan did?」

name: Synn
message: 「She told me to have you teach me, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... M-Me?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though she's the one who suggested it, she then told me to forget it because a guy is supposed to lead a girl.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, when it comes to dancing, there's nothing I can really do on my own...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, sorry to keep you waiting!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello~」

name: Misa
message: 「What were you doing, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nothing! Just going over the agenda」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So there is something you need to decide on」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Um, about today's agenda--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun's expression totally changes the second it comes to Student Council business~~」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What am I staring at, geez\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「--And so, since not everyone knows how to dance, I was thinking we could hold a dance workshop or something」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on a second. Who's going to teach it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, us downtown-raised folks can't do it, but... surely the high-society ladies can pull it off, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am an angel, so I cannot dance」

name: Synn
message: 「And she owns up to it so shamelessly」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is stranger for a king to be unable to dance」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh. 198 damage to my heart!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, our last hope is...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I suppose it can't be helped. Leave this to--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's gotta be Ria-senpai, after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you think, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph. If it's Onee-sama, I have no objections」

name: Misa
message: 「I have no doubt she will grace us with her magnificent and lovely steps\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san is quite skilled at teaching others, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Zero objections! Now it's settled as long as you're okay with it, Senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun is staring... Uuu... I can't say no...」

name: Ria
message: 「A-All right. If you insist that much, I, Ria Kujou, will teach everyone how to dance!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoaaa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Way to go, Ria-senpai」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of you...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Ahem!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, assuming we hold the general workshop sometime the week before...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, right here! December 17th!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We should do a dry run with just us beforehand, shouldn't we」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a brilliant idea! With one-on-one lessons from Onee-sama\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, let's get started right away with us as your students--」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah! Oh right, oops. My big sister actually called for me today」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry, I'm gonna run to the chairwoman's office real quick--\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh my」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's quite busy, isn't she~~」

name: Misa
message: 「So dreamy...\s04」
Is it really okay to just keep relying completely on Ria-senpai?
I'm the Student Council President, too.
I've got to practice dancing so I can set a good example for the students.
That said, I can't embarrass myself in front of everyone.
Staying behind to practice after everyone goes home.

name: Synn
message: 「Yo, ho, ho, whoops, AAAAH!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ugh, I can't watch this anymore. Prez, isn't dinner ready yet~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan!? How long have you been there!?」

name: Sally
message: 「I've been here the whole time. I'm super starving already. Stop playing around and let's eat~~」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay, got it. I'll be home soon, so go ahead and cook the rice!」

name: Sally
message: 「Roger that」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Alright, one more time. One-two-three, uno-dos-tres」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa!! Ria-senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, what... are you doing?」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, could it be... dance practice?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even 'could it be'--that's exactly what it is」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry! I didn't mean to peek, though\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「No... well, I figured it'd look pretty lame if the Student Council President couldn't dance...」

name: Synn
message: 「So I've been practicing in secret, though doing it alone isn't really working out...」

name: Ria
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Honestly, I did think about asking you for help, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'm a guy, after all. I have to get good enough to lead you properly, Ria-senpai. Yep」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun... come on... that's not fair」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa--\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you are a boy, I'm still a third-year upperclassman, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry... for speaking out of turn」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, pushing yourself like that won't make you any better, y'know!」

name: Ria
message: 「A-As a special exception, you're going to take private lessons from Teacher Ria」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It's already late today so we can't start now, okay\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... but if I just keep relying on Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」

name: Ria
message: 「If I end up letting Synn-kun take the lead... I won't be much of a senpai anymore...」

name: Helena
message: 「Riaaa. I'm done with work, so for our special dance train--」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaa!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my. You were here, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hurry on home now. You'll make Ria worry, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha... I'm not a kid anymore, so I'll be fine!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「I got what you said earlier. Still, I'll practice on my own too! Excuse me!」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Be careful, okay?」

name: Helena
message: 「Bye-byyyee, zoom-zooom♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Is Synn-chan finally going through his rebellious phase?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it's a little different from that\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, that means we need to buckle down even more on that special dance training」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh」
